summary: The implementation addresses all three requirements with backend data structures, admin reset page, and dashboard placeholders. However, a Migration.mo file was created despite being explicitly listed as a non-goal.

hallucinated_features.description: Migration.mo file created with full migration logic including LegacyActor and NewActor types
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest explicitly lists 'Migration.mo file (not needed for this modification)' as a non-goal. The constraint states 'Keep all Motoko logic in the single main actor file (backend/main.mo)', yet a separate migration module was created.
